movie.title: Club Kid
movie.overview: A hard-partying New York City club promoter sees his whirlwind lifestyle upended by the arrival of the 10-year-old son he never knew he had.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: A high-flying New York City club promoter is forced to reassess his wild lifestyle when the ten-year-old son he never knew existed suddenly enters his life.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Set against the vibrant backdrop of New York City's nightlife, a dedicated club promoter thrives on non-stop parties, late nights, and zero responsibilities. His carefully cultivated world is turned upside down when a ten-year-old boy shows up on his doorstep, revealing himself to be the son he never knew he had. Navigating the chaotic shift from party host to parent, he must choose between the superficial thrill of the night and the genuine responsibility of family. Ultimately, the unexpected relationship challenges him to grow up and find real meaning beyond the velvet ropes.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Life for a prominent New York City club promoter revolves entirely around nightlife, status, and an endless stream of late-night parties. Content with his fast-paced, commitment-free routine, he spends his days sleeping and his nights running the city's most exclusive venues. Everything changes in an instant when a quiet, ten-year-old boy arrives unannounced, revealing a past relationship that left behind a secret son. Initially overwhelmed and ill-equipped for parenthood, the promoter attempts to balance his demanding nightlife career with the unfamiliar routine of caring for a child. Dragging his son into his unconventional world leads to both hilarious misadventures and poignant reality checks. As the boy begins to ground him, the promoter starts to see the emptiness of the shallow party scene he once treasured. However, balancing his old obligations with his new parental role creates escalating tension with his business associates and himself. Through shared moments, vulnerable conversations, and key turning points, he discovers a deep capacity for love and responsibility. By the end, he steps up to become the father his son needs, realizing that true fulfillment comes from authentic connection rather than the temporary highs of the dance floor.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Club Kid is a touching comedy-drama that explores themes of unexpected fatherhood, maturity, and redemption within the electric atmosphere of the New York City nightlife industry. The story follows a charismatic, self-absorbed club promoter whose entire identity is tied to the glamour and chaos of the city's party scene. When the ten-year-old son he never knew existed suddenly enters his life, he is forced to confront the stark contrast between his hedonistic lifestyle and the grounding responsibilities of parenthood. Blending humorous culture-clash dynamics with heartfelt dramatic moments, the narrative traces a man's transformative journey from living purely for the moment to learning how to show up for someone else.

story_structure.climax: A major crisis forces him to choose between a high-stakes opportunity in the club scene and being there for his son when it matters most.
story_structure.conflict: His self-centered world is suddenly disrupted when he discovers he has a 10-year-old son he never knew existed, forcing him to take immediate responsibility.
story_structure.resolution: He undergoes a profound personal shift, redefining his priorities and working toward a stable, meaningful relationship with his child.
story_structure.introduction: A charismatic New York City club promoter thrives in a fast-paced, hedonistic nightlife scene, completely immersed in party culture and career ambition.
story_structure.risingAction: As he attempts to balance his chaotic, late-night career with the demands of unexpected fatherhood, friction builds between his old, reckless lifestyle and the growing emotional bond with his son.
